title: Effervescence-assisted carbon nanotubes dispersion for micro-solid-phase extraction of triazine herbicides
author: Lasarte Aragonés, Guillermo
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Prepare effervescent tablet
steps.instruction: Mix sodium carbonate (CO₂ source), sodium dihydrogen phosphate (proton donor), and multiwalled carbon nanotubes (MWCNTs) and compress the mixture into a tablet.

steps.title: Add sample to beaker
steps.instruction: Place 100 mL of the water sample into a clean glass beaker.

steps.title: Generate CO₂ and disperse sorbent
steps.instruction: Introduce the prepared tablet into the beaker; the tablet reacts in situ to generate carbon dioxide, causing effervescence that disperses the MWCNTs throughout the 100 mL sample.

steps.title: Recover MWCNTs
steps.instruction: After the extraction period, collect the MWCNTs (now loaded with analytes) by vacuum filtration.

steps.title: Elute analytes with methanol
steps.instruction: Pass methanol through the filtered MWCNTs to elute the retained triazine herbicides.
